summary: Initialize one fresh native Core workspace at .twig/core.db. No legacy cache, migration or reset.
Set the active work item by ID or title pattern.
Display an explicitly cached Core item without changing context; --local-id retains original draft UUIDs and permanent mappings.
Display multiple work items by ID (cache-only). Missing IDs are disclosed and exit nonzero.
Search using bounded provider-qualified Core queries. GitHub supports title/body/state only, with at most 100 total candidates.
Change the state of the active work item by name.
Show process configuration: list types (no args) or type details (with type name).
Describe the admitted provider's Core schema (core-schema-1), with explicit scope and presentation gaps.
Human-only alias for the active work item's states; structured callers must use process <type>.
Display a targeted static Core work-item hierarchy; full workspace layout is unsupported.
Navigate to the parent work item.
Navigate to a child work item.
Navigate to the next sibling work item.
Navigate to the previous sibling work item.
Create a new local seed work item.
Edit seed fields in an external editor.
Discard (delete) a local seed.
Show seed dashboard grouped by parent.
Create a virtual link between two items (at least one must be a seed).
Remove a virtual link between two items.
List virtual links, optionally filtered by item ID.
Create a chain of linked seeds — interactively or from explicit titles.
Validate seeds against publish rules.
Publish seeds to Azure DevOps. Use --all for batch, --dry-run to preview, --force to skip validation, --link-branch to link to a git branch.
Reconcile stale seed links and parent references after partial publishes.
Set the parent of an unparented published item through a verified Core proposal.
Remove the one observed native parent through a verified Core proposal.
Parent replacement is unsupported; refuses before HTTP without removing any link.
Mark the active work item as blocked by another item (Predecessor link).
Mark the active work item as blocking another item (Successor link).
Relate the active work item to another item (symmetric Related link).
Remove a Related link between the active work item and another item.
Create an explicit LOCAL, non-native Related association through a Verified local CAS proposal. May acquire native metadata/observations; never mutates native links.
Tombstone an existing LOCAL Related association through its exact local CAS. Native reads may occur; no native mutation.
List cached LOCAL associations for an explicit item. Zero HTTP; no schema acquisition or context change.
Remove a non-hierarchy link (predecessor, successor, or related) from a work item.
Add an artifact link (URL or vstfs:// URI) to a work item.
Batch state transitions, field updates, and notes in a single call.
Add a note to the active work item.
Update a field on the active work item.
Atomically patch multiple fields on a work item via JSON input.
Edit work item fields in an external editor.
Discard pending changes for a single item or all dirty items.
Save selected staged Core intent through its proposal journal; does not perform a sync pull.
Save retained remote drafts through the proposal journal, then pull the selected Bench.
Refresh the local cache from the active provider. Routes through sync --pull-only.
Read cached Core Bench membership and all protected drafts as a static table. Acquires provider schema metadata.
Read the static cached Core Bench workspace (short alias); acquires provider schema metadata.
Track a single work item by ID (pinned to workspace).
Track a work item and its subtree.
Remove explicit pins, optionally only single or tree; inherited membership remains.
Pull only the current Bench's query, pin, and bounded relationship scope; never flush pending writes.
Exclude a work item from workspace view.
List all excluded work items.
Create a Bench with a name you will recognise later.
List the Benches that exist, marking the current one.
List the Benches that exist, marking the current one.
Rename a user-wide Bench without changing its pins or context selections.
Stand on another Bench. Naming one that does not exist fails; nothing is created.
Delete a Bench. One holding pins reports what it holds and deletes nothing.
List the exact shared Bench pins/rules and captured revision; no provider reads.
Add one connection-qualified shared rule. Conditions inside it are AND; independent Bench pins/rules are OR.
Remove one captured shared pin/rule without deleting any upstream item or local draft.
Read cached native planning metadata without refreshing it or changing any Bench.
Read the current context's cached native planning metadata; alias of bench planning.
Explicitly refresh native areas and the exact selected team's iteration calendar; no work items or Bench rules change.
Discover native saved-query hierarchy and exact-team backlogs; does not execute them or change selection.
Explicitly acquire saved-query/backlog membership and item bodies into the native cache; never pins, selects or publishes.
Show the current Bench's cached view, including its shared planning rules and protected drafts.
Add an area to the current Bench's planning rule; areas are OR, area/iteration/ownership categories are AND.
Remove one area from the current Bench's planning rule; other pins, rules and workspace exclusions are preserved.
List saved shared area paths and exact/under semantics without fetching items.
Refresh native planning metadata only; does not replace or populate shared Bench rules.
Add an iteration expression to the current Bench's planning rule; union iterations and preserve area/ownership constraints.
Remove one saved iteration expression; never replace the last rule with an all-items query.
List saved absolute/relative iteration expressions and canonical teams without remote item acquisition.
Inspect local authentication state without refreshing. Use --provider github for a selected GitHub App identity.
Enroll an explicit identity. ADO uses loopback PKCE by default; --provider github uses Twig's GitHub App device flow without a shipped secret.
List every registered identity (AAD and PAT) with safe principal metadata. Credential blobs are never surfaced; AAD rows show tenant/objectId/authorityHost, PAT rows show adoPrincipalId/adoAuthority.

Enroll or renew a Personal Access Token identity. The PAT is read from a non-echoing Spectre prompt on a TTY, or from stdin when --stdin is set or stdin is redirected; it is never accepted as an argument. The service performs authoritative read-only principal attestation before touching any stored credential.
Bind an endpoint (org/project) to a registered identity. Use --default to request this as the initial default; the service refuses to switch an existing different default.
List bindings for an endpoint (org/project). Falls back to the workspace's checked-in coordinates when both --org and --project are omitted.
Show the identity + binding the current attached worktree resolves to. Fails with setup guidance when there is no attachment or the binding is ambiguous; no fallback.
Inspect native remote-write intents, immutable acknowledgments and uncertainty blockers for the attached checkout. Read-only; never replay, expire or discard an unknown write.
Show the current version.
Validate a proposal's canonical file format offline. Preview separately checks application evidence; no mutation.
Preview a proposal with an optional digest guard. No ADO mutation.
Apply a proposal when --confirm <digest> matches the current file digest exactly. Canonical verb is proposal apply; plan apply is a retained deprecated alias.
Inspect journal states and receipts for an exact proposal digest without applying or settling it; exit 1 when absent.
Inspect captured typed draft fields, original baselines and seed relationships in retained draft order. Read-only.
Install the generic Twig skill family into an explicit root.
Update unedited Twig-owned guidance while preserving companions.
Select or clear an additive companion for one provider and scenario.
Inspect installed guidance identity, integrity and bounded discovery.
Install one separately supplied integration or variant skill.
